selection_policy: Pool: all 250 LAB tasks under tasks/firm-knowledge/, which share the firm-knowledge/dms document store through docs_dir; no eligibility filter (apply_task_filter: false). Stratified by 9b difficulty (gpt-5.6-sol high, LAB-exact harness, one trial per task): tasks sorted by (9b dual all-pass rate, 9b criterion pass rate, sha256('harvey-lab-campaign-12:order:' + task_id)), cut into 10 blocks of 25; within each block, tasks sorted by sha256('harvey-lab-campaign-12:assign:' + task_id): first 2 test, next 2 validation, next 8 train, other 13 not used. Each split is listed sorted by task id. Built by scripts/make_splits_firm_knowledge_c12.py. Pins are sha256 of task.json and of the document tree hash map (the shared store).
